title: Sprites
description: Move a player with the arrow keys and print where it is.
tryChanging: Change how far each arrow press moves the player.
Make Friend glide to a different corner.
Print a message when the player is clicked.

title: Motion
description: Glide, point toward the pointer, bounce and talk.
tryChanging: Make the sprite glide faster or slower.
Change what the sprite says when it bounces.
Point toward a fixed spot instead of the pointer.

title: Story
description: Characters speak, animate and change backdrops.
tryChanging: Write new lines for the characters.
Switch to a different backdrop when Space is pressed.
Make the animation play twice.

title: Drawing
description: Sprite pens, stamps and repeating patterns.
tryChanging: Change the number of repeats.
Use a different pen color.
Stamp at every turn instead of every step.

title: Behaviors
description: A bird with its own data, clones and update events.
tryChanging: Make each clone a different size.
Change how often the bird makes clones.
Give the bird a new data value and show it.

title: Platformer
description: Run, jump on ledges and reach the goal star.
tryChanging: Make the jump higher.
Move a ledge to make it harder.
Make the explorer walk faster.

title: Worlds
description: Tile maps, a following camera and two worlds.
tryChanging: Paint a new wall in [[Worlds & tilemaps]].
Make the camera stop following.
Move the flag to a new spot.

title: Star game
description: Collect stars, avoid hazards and beat the countdown.
tryChanging: Give yourself more time on the countdown.
Change the winning message.
Make a hazard give back a life instead.

title: Music
description: A singer with notes, rhythm and volume.
tryChanging: Change two notes in the melody.
Make the tune slower with tempo.
Use a different instrument.

title: Input & color
description: Ask questions, time the player and sense colors.
tryChanging: Ask a different question.
Change the color the explorer must find.
Show the timer when you win.

title: Catch the star
description: Fly a bird with the arrow keys and catch a star five times.
tryChanging: Make the star move faster when you catch it.
Win at 10 stars instead of 5.
Add a countdown.

title: Dodge the balls
description: Balls fall from the sky. Survive for 30 seconds.
tryChanging: Make the balls fall faster.
Start with more lives.
Make more balls appear.

title: Pen patterns
description: A flower drawn by a loop inside a loop.
tryChanging: Turn 45 degrees and repeat 8 times.
Draw triangles instead of squares.
Change the pen color.

title: Talking story
description: Two characters talk, music plays and night falls.
tryChanging: Write your own dialogue.
Play a different tune.
Make the bird say something new at night.

title: Jump quest
description: Jump up the ledges, fire with x and reach the goal.
tryChanging: Jump higher or lower.
Fire projectiles faster.
Move the goal star.

title: Maze run
description: Explore a tile world and find the door to another world.
tryChanging: Paint more walls to make a harder maze.
Move the flag.
Make the explorer slower.

title: Brick Breaker
description: Bounce the ball off your paddle and clear a wall of 24 bricks.
tryChanging: Make the ball faster: change its vx and vy.
Add a fourth row of bricks, and change the winning score to match.
Make the paddle wider: select it, press [[Paint]], then More, Canvas size.

title: Flappy Flight
description: Tap space to flap through the gaps. Ten pipes win; one bump ends the flight.
tryChanging: Make the gaps easier: change the random heights or the wait between pipes.
Make gravity stronger or the flap weaker, then try to win again.
Change the winning score from 10 to 20.

title: Super Hopper
description: Run and jump through a five-screen level: coins, pits, beetles and a flag at the end.
tryChanging: Jump higher: change the 520 in the jump block.
Make the beetles faster: change their vx from −60 to −120.
Make the level longer: in [[Stage view]], press [[Add screen]] and paint more ground.
